description: Installable Candidate for 480p eight-step image-to-video with a complete immutable step-distilled Diffusers snapshot, isolated image input, and offline ARM64 runtime; physical Spark acceptance remains pending. Keeps models on CUDA without CPU offload on GB10 unified memory; smoke fit is estimated, and physical memory and latency qualification remain pending.
title: HunyuanVideo 1.5 I2V 480p step-distilled diffusers single Spark
